create_colormap_rgb: create an Nx3 RGB colormap array with values in [0, 255] range
create_colormap_bgr: create an Nx3 BGR colormap array with values in [0, 1] range
generate_random_color: generate a single random color from the detectron2 colormap
generate_random_colors: generate N unique random colors from the detectron2 colormap
run_colormap_preview: run the colormap preview CLI to display all colors in a grid window
